en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Who 'Јана мајка' is (a mother named Jana, or Jana cursing her mother) is ambiguous; I took it as written. 'Да се видам' translated as 'see anyone' is my reading; 'метам' (spread/lay out) with courtyards is also a loose reading.

lines.en: Mother Jana, my soul, curses bitterly:

lines.cyr: - Што ме даде мајко на далеку,
lines.lat: - Što me dade majko na daleku,
lines.en: - Why did you give me, mother, far away,
Across the Vardar, mother, to the beys,
across the Vardar, mother, to the beys,
to spread out for them level courtyards,

lines.cyr: Да не можам, џанам, да се видам,
lines.lat: Da ne možam, džanam, da se vidam,
lines.en: So that I cannot, my soul, see anyone,

lines.cyr: да не можам џанум да се видам,
lines.lat: da ne možam džanum da se vidam,
lines.en: so that I cannot, my soul, see anyone,

lines.cyr: ни со мајка, ни со татко,
lines.lat: ni so majka, ni so tatko,
lines.en: neither my mother, nor my father,
